overall_summary: Analysis of 25 uploaded Shorts shows strong audience interest in large-scale cosmic physics, planetary alterations, and fundamental force shifts (e.g., Earth rings generating 1,040 views and 51.26% retention; dropping the speed of light generating 548 views and 40.89% retention). Minor abstract physical changes (e.g., seeing Wi-Fi signals, sand to glass, water to mercury) consistently underperform with under 20 views. Retention curve data reveals significant viewer drop-off within the first 10% progress when hooks lack immediate high-impact visuals or clear stakes.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' achieved 1,040 views with a 51.26% average view percentage and 31s average view duration. 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' gained 664 views with 40.94% retention.
what_is_working.action: Double down on large-scale planetary and physics alteration scenarios that carry instant visual scale and high curiosity.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' yielded 866 views and 19 likes. 'What If Gravity Pulled Sideways for 10 Seconds?' generated 418 views and sustained 49.23% audience retention at 23% progress.
what_is_working.action: Format hooks around precise, short duration countdowns ('for 5 Seconds', 'for 10 Seconds') to induce urgency and force high early retention.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' reached only 16 views. 'What If All Sand Turned to Glass?' and 'What If Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury?' reached 19 views each.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid abstract human-perception ideas or low-stakes material shifts; focus strictly on global-scale physical consequences.

what_to_improve.pattern: Slow Initial Visual Hook & Delayed Stakes
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' dropped to 10.09% relative retention by 8% progress. 'What If a Rogue Planet Passed Between Earth and the Moon?' plummeted to 73.68% audience watch ratio by 10% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Deliver the core visual transformation within the first 1.5 seconds rather than setting up preamble text or slow narrative build.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Fundamental Physics Alteration ('Speed of Light Dropped to Speed of Sound')
retention_insights.evidence: Maintained 0.984 audience watch ratio at 10% progress and held a high 0.6294 ratio at 23% progress, leading to a 40.89% average view percentage.
retention_insights.action: Maintain fast multi-step escalation in pacing around the 5-15 second mark to sustain the high initial retention spike.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Fluid Dynamics Shift ('Water Lost All Surface Tension')
retention_insights.evidence: Audience watch ratio dropped from 1.1471 at 1% progress down to 0.9412 at 10% progress and fell steeply to 0.5588 by 23% progress.
retention_insights.action: Place the payoff/visual climax before 15% progress instead of back-loading the main simulation payoff.

best_posting_windows.reason: Highest performing uploads published around 04:47 - 04:56 UTC, yielding the top performer with 1,040 views ('Earth Had Rings') and 664 views ('Sound in Space').
Strong performance window with uploads at 12:08 UTC achieving 866 views ('Earth Lost Atmosphere 5s') and consistently stable traffic.
